encryption.control: Customer-managed symmetric KMS key is enabled
Automatic KMS key rotation is enabled
Primary and audit buckets use SSE-KMS default encryption with S3 Bucket Keys
Glue S3, CloudWatch Logs, and bookmark encryption use the ZIPCO KMS key
Athena result encryption is enforced as SSE_KMS
New Glue Data Catalog metadata uses SSE-KMS with a service role

identity_and_access.control: Data engineer role is prefix- and service-scoped
Risk analyst role is read/query scoped
Data steward role is metadata and contract scoped
Security auditor role cannot mutate data-lake resources
All four human personas require MFA for role assumption
Account-level IAM Access Analyzer is active

audit_and_detection.control: Multi-region CloudTrail is logging management events
CloudTrail log-file integrity validation is enabled
CloudTrail logs are KMS encrypted and retained in a dedicated private bucket
Primary-bucket S3 object events are recorded when the cost switch is enabled
Root usage, denied API calls, and KMS destructive changes generate metrics and alarms
Security dashboard and CloudWatch audit query are available

configuration_and_data_governance.control: Fifteen AWS managed rules evaluate storage, trail, KMS, and identity posture
Weekly S3 Inventory records encryption and object metadata
Catalog databases carry ownership/classification/version tags and all tables are covered by the versioned column-level classification catalog
Data classification catalog defines column-level handling classes
Risk-engine use remains human-reviewed and prohibited for automated adverse decisions

boundaries.existing_s3_objects: Changing default encryption does not re-encrypt existing object versions; migration requires a separately approved copy or S3 Batch Operations plan.
boundaries.lake_formation: This phase adds classification and role governance without revoking IAMAllowedPrincipals or changing live Lake Formation authorization.
boundaries.macie: Amazon Macie is not enabled because the dataset is synthetic and the service adds cost; enable it before processing real sensitive data.
boundaries.notifications: Alarms are deployed without external notification targets. Production promotion requires an approved SNS, PagerDuty, Slack, or ticketing destination.
boundaries.risk_model: Scores prioritize synthetic records for human review only and are not fraud, AML, credit, eligibility, or adverse-action decisions.
